title: Ensure AI literacy
description: Take measures to ensure staff and other persons dealing with the operation and use of the AI system on the organization's behalf have sufficient AI literacy, considering their technical knowledge, experience, education, and the context the system is used in.
gapQuestion: Have staff working with this system received AI literacy training appropriate to their role?

title: Internal AI governance policy
description: Adopt and maintain an internal AI governance policy covering roles, responsibilities, risk management approach, and oversight for AI systems used or provided by the organization.
gapQuestion: Is there a documented internal AI governance policy covering this system?

title: Transparency obligations, if applicable
description: If the system interacts directly with natural persons, generates synthetic audio/image/video/text content, or performs emotion recognition or biometric categorization, confirm whether the relevant transparency disclosures apply (e.g. informing users they are interacting with an AI system, labeling AI-generated or manipulated content, disclosing emotion recognition or biometric categorization) and implement them.
gapQuestion: Where applicable, are users told they are interacting with an AI system or seeing AI-generated content?

title: Risk management system
description: Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system as a continuous iterative process throughout the system's lifecycle.
gapQuestion: Is a documented, ongoing risk management system in place for this system?

title: Data and data governance
description: Apply data governance and management practices to training, validation and testing data sets: relevant design choices, data collection, bias examination, and gaps/shortcomings identification.
gapQuestion: Are training/validation/testing data sets governed with documented collection, bias-examination and quality practices?

title: Technical documentation (Annex IV)
description: Draw up technical documentation before the system is placed on the market or put into service, and keep it up to date, demonstrating compliance with Chapter III Section 2.
gapQuestion: Does an up-to-date Annex IV technical documentation dossier exist for this system?

title: Automatic logging / record-keeping
description: Design the system to enable automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime, to a level enabling traceability of its functioning appropriate to its intended purpose.
gapQuestion: Does the system automatically log events to a level that makes its outputs traceable?

title: Transparency & instructions for use
description: Design the system to be sufficiently transparent for deployers to interpret its output, and accompany it with instructions for use containing the information deployers need.
gapQuestion: Is the system accompanied by instructions for use that let deployers correctly interpret its output?

title: Human oversight design
description: Design the system, including appropriate human-machine interface tools, so it can be effectively overseen by natural persons during the period it is in use.
gapQuestion: Does the system's design let a human effectively oversee and intervene in its operation?

title: Accuracy, robustness & cybersecurity
description: Design and develop the system to achieve an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity, and to perform consistently across its lifecycle.
gapQuestion: Has the system been tested and hardened for accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity?

title: Quality management system
description: Put in place a quality management system covering regulatory compliance strategy, design control, data management, risk management, and post-market monitoring.
gapQuestion: Is a quality management system in place covering this system's compliance strategy and controls?

title: Conformity assessment procedure
description: Carry out the applicable conformity assessment procedure before placing the system on the market or putting it into service, and whenever a substantial modification is made.
gapQuestion: Has the applicable conformity assessment procedure been carried out for this system?

title: EU declaration of conformity
description: Draw up a written EU declaration of conformity for each system and keep it available to national authorities for 10 years after the system is placed on the market.
gapQuestion: Has a written EU declaration of conformity been drawn up and retained for this system?

title: CE marking
description: Affix the CE marking to the system (or its documentation/packaging, if physical marking isn't possible) to indicate conformity.
gapQuestion: Has the CE marking been affixed to the system or its documentation/packaging?

title: Registration in EU database
description: Register the system in the EU database for high-risk AI systems before placing it on the market or putting it into service.
gapQuestion: Is the system registered in the EU database for high-risk AI systems?

title: Post-market monitoring system
description: Establish and document a post-market monitoring system proportionate to the nature of the AI technology and risks, to actively collect and review performance data over the system's lifetime.
gapQuestion: Is there a documented post-market monitoring system collecting performance data on this system?

title: Serious incident reporting
description: Report serious incidents to the market surveillance authorities of the Member States concerned, within the timelines set out in Art. 73.
gapQuestion: Is there a process in place to report serious incidents to market surveillance authorities within the required timelines?

title: Use the system per the provider's instructions
description: Take appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure the system is used in accordance with the instructions for use accompanying it.
gapQuestion: Are technical and organisational measures in place to ensure the system is used per the provider's instructions?

title: Assign competent, trained human oversight
description: Assign human oversight to natural persons who have the necessary competence, training, authority, and support to exercise it effectively.
gapQuestion: Is human oversight of this system assigned to people with the competence and authority to exercise it effectively?

title: Monitor operation & report risks
description: Monitor the system's operation based on the instructions for use and, where relevant, inform the provider and/or distributor and market surveillance authority when a risk under Art. 79(1) is identified, and suspend use where appropriate.
gapQuestion: Is the system's operation actively monitored, with a process to report identified risks and suspend use if needed?

title: Keep automatically generated logs
description: Keep the logs automatically generated by the system, to the extent under the deployer's control, for a period appropriate to the system's intended purpose (at least 6 months, unless other law provides otherwise).
gapQuestion: Are the system's automatically generated logs retained for at least 6 months?

title: Inform workers' representatives & affected workers
description: Where the deployer is an employer, inform workers' representatives and affected workers that they will be subject to the use of the high-risk AI system, before putting it into use in the workplace.
gapQuestion: If deployed in the workplace, have workers' representatives and affected workers been informed before go-live?

title: Inform natural persons subject to the system
description: Where the system is used to make or assist decisions about natural persons, inform those persons that they are subject to its use, and provide the required information about the decision(s) taken.
gapQuestion: Are people subject to this system's decisions informed that it was used and given the required information?

title: Fundamental rights impact assessment
description: For deployers that are bodies governed by public law, private operators providing public services, or deployers of the credit/insurance-risk systems named in Annex III, carry out a fundamental rights impact assessment before first use. Mark as not applicable if the deployer doesn't fall into one of these categories.
gapQuestion: If this obligation applies to your organization, has a fundamental rights impact assessment been carried out?

title: Register use in EU database (public bodies)
description: Deployers that are public authorities, or bodies acting on their behalf, must register the use of the system in the relevant section of the EU database before putting it into use. Mark as not applicable for private-sector deployers.
gapQuestion: If this obligation applies to your organization, is the system's use registered in the EU database?
